entities.summary: Muboraksho Abdulvahhobovich Mirzoshoyev, better known as Muboraksho (Муборакшо) or Misha (Миша), was a Tajikistani Pamiri singer and composer recognized alongside Daler Nazarov as a pioneer of rock music.
